question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A large cage, building, or enclosure to keep birds
solution:
The correct answer is **"Aviary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Aviary" **means a large cage or area in which birds are kept. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा)

 
 
• **Example:** *The zoo has a beautiful **aviary**__ with exotic birds.*
 
 
 
• **"Aviary"** is a one-word substitute for a large cage, building, or enclosure to keep birds.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Burrow** means a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, such as a rabbit or a fox. ((ख़रगोश, लोमड़ी आदि का) बिल)
 
• **Apiary** means a place where bees are kept for their honey. (मधुवाटिका)
 
• **Dormitory** means a large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution. (अनेक पलंगों वाला बड़ा शयनकक्ष (विशेषतः स्‍कूल आदि में))
